Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our discussion I’ve attached a draft Mutual Action Plan focused on capacity reservation for the Dedicated/Private routes: we captured the options we discussed for GPU pool sizing and the procurement lead-time assumptions.

Quick highlights:
- Proposal A: 8-node H100 private tranche (baseline) — target go-live 12 weeks post-signature; recommended if you need deterministic latency for inference.
- Proposal B: 4-node H100 + burst to hosted (cost-saving) — target go-live 8 weeks post-signature but with phased SLA uplift.
- Acceptance gates: SOC2 evidence verified, staging performance run (50k tokens/day), API latency SLOs verified under 75th/95th percentile.

Can you confirm Nexa’s preferred tranche (A/B) and procurement constraints so we can lock lead times in the MAP? I’ve cc’d Ben (capacity & procurement playbook) to add concrete lead-time numbers / procurement checklist.

Next step: once you confirm the tranche we’ll finalize the MAP, attach the procurement SOW, and route the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Sofia

Thanks Sofia — this looks useful. A couple of questions from our side before we commit to A vs B:

1) Lead times: can you confirm the firm equipment lead time window for the private H100 tranche (calendar weeks) once we sign? We need that to line up with our quarterly release.
2) Acceptance criteria: for the staging performance run, what does Redwood define as the pass/fail thresholds (latency percentiles, throughput)?
3) Cost delta: rough monthly cost delta between Proposal A and Proposal B (we know hosted burst has variable costs; we need a forecast).

Procurement told us they prefer shorter lead times or a staged commitment to reduce capex risk. If you can provide precise timelines and a minimal SOW for the first tranche we’ll get internal buy-in quicker.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — can we aim to finalize tranche choice by EOD Friday?

— Alex

Alex / Sofia —

Quick answers and concrete timelines to unblock procurement: (numbers below assume standard allocation leadtimes and current supplier queue)

- Private H100 tranche (Proposal A): 10–12 calendar weeks from signed order to provisioned customer-staging environment. Leadtime risk: ±2 weeks if supply chain shifts; we can reduce to 8–10 weeks with a small expedited fee or by accepting 2-node warm standby.

- Hybrid (Proposal B): ~6–8 weeks to get the 4-node baseline into staging + hosted-burst configuration (no hardware procurement). This reduces up-front capex and shortens the path to performance testing.

- Acceptance thresholds for staging perf run (recommended pass criteria):
  • 75th percentile latency ≤ 120ms on the baseline prompt mix
  • 95th percentile latency ≤ 250ms
  • Sustained throughput: 50k tokens/day during a 24–72 hour soak with no memory/instability errors
  • Token-quality regression: automated eval on your seed prompts shows ≤ 1.5% decline vs baseline model (we’ll provide eval harness)

- Cost delta (very rough forecast; final pricing in SOW):
  • Proposal A (8-node H100 private): estimated $Xk/month (includes reserved capacity uplift and support SLA).
  • Proposal B (4-node private + hosted burst): estimated $Yk/month (lower baseline, higher variable burst).

Attachments: I’m attaching a short procurement checklist and the GPU pool options PDF we referenced (gpu_pool_options.pdf). I’ll also prepare a minimal SOW draft for Proposal B if Nexa prefers to stage.

If Nexa can confirm a preferred tranche by EOD Friday we’ll:
1) Lock lead-times into the MAP
2) Push a minimal SOW and a version of the MAP to DocuSign for signature
3) Provision a staging window (2–3 weeks) for performance validation immediately after signature

— Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Capacity Solutions, Redwood Inference

Alex / Team —

Thanks — Ben’s timeline and the acceptance gates look good to me. To keep procurement moving, here are the concrete MAP commitments we’ll put into the next revision:

- Commitment milestone 1 (sign SOW + MAP): DocuSign link (final) will be sent once Nexa confirms tranche. Target: sign by 2026-07-09.
- Milestone 2 (staging provisioned): 6–12 weeks post-signature depending on tranche; we’ll list the tranche-specific expected calendar dates in the MAP and mark the 10% buffer for supply variance.
- Milestone 3 (performance acceptance): 2–3 day soak with the pass/fail criteria Ben listed. We’ll capture the exact prompt set for the eval in the MAP appendix.
- Fallback policy: if private H100 lead times slip beyond 14 weeks we’ll provide a temporary hosted-burst lane with configured KV-prefix caching and reduced cost ceilings until hardware arrives.

Action items:
- Alex / Nexa: confirm Proposal A or B by EOD Friday (2026-07-09) so we can route DocuSign.
- Procurement: if you need a staged SOW (Proposal B first, A later), confirm the preferred milestone payment cadence and we’ll adjust the MAP.

I’ll circulate the updated MAP and SOW by tomorrow EOD.

Best,
Sofia
